reason: A private shadow scheduler mutates scheduled-pair and history state when its command send succeeds. Advancing a nonselected shadow would falsely commit commands that NSESche never dispatched. In particular, an All-frontier Jiagu or Orion shadow advanced during the initial OCS phase would suppress real pending players after a later causal route switch. This violates exact native semantics and the plan's same-realized-state premise.
unchanged: the frame-20 threshold 70 and frame-100 threshold 213
the OCS low, FaaSRank middle, and Jiagu high route
the low OCS-cohort Orion service-and-welfare certificate
the exact 60 E01-E20 candidate cells and 60 references
all nine mean gates, all nine paired gates, and the no-claim training boundary
the prohibition on outcome-driven seed deletion, replacement, relabeling, or selective rerun

replacement_lifecycle_contract.selected_state_only: Only the scheduler state whose emitted command cohort is used as the current NSESche initializer may commit scheduled-pair and bounded-history mutations for that window.
replacement_lifecycle_contract.initial_phase: Instantiate one OCS state at run start and advance it once per frame while the route is unclassified. Its exact native PreAllSched cohort is the default initializer.
replacement_lifecycle_contract.low_branch: Retain and advance the same OCS state once per frame. Construct a fresh stateless Orion scorer from the current realized environment for that window; project only its exact node choices for the OCS cohort. Discard the Orion scorer after the window because its All-frontier commands were not dispatched.
replacement_lifecycle_contract.middle_transition: When the frame-100 classifier first freezes middle, initialize a new FaaSRank state from that frame's realized environment, then advance only that state once per later frame on its exact PreAllDone frontier.
replacement_lifecycle_contract.high_transition: When the frame-20 classifier first freezes high, initialize a new Jiagu state from that frame's realized environment, then advance only that state once per later frame on its exact All frontier.
replacement_lifecycle_contract.fail_closed: Any duplicate selected invocation, nonselected persistent-state mutation, missing transition initialization, incomplete native cohort, or route reclassification fails the blind audit before performance reveal.

interpretation: V149 remains a causal NSESche optimizer with native initialization. The amendment removes an invalid counterfactual-state assumption; it does not add a candidate, change a threshold, consult a new outcome, or authorize an execution.
